messages:
Asha (People Ops): Heads-up — cohort of 3 starts tomorrow. Two will be on-site, one remote. Need I-9 verification for the two in-office folks between 9:00–11:00. Who can staff the kiosk/escort? :eyes:
Ben (Ops): I can take 9:00–10:00.
Jorge (Facilities): I’ll cover 10:00–11:00 and handle the escort. Do we have parking sorted for them?
Asha (People Ops): We have 2 visitor permits available. Jorge, please submit the license plate info here: https://intranet.redwood/parking/permit-request — front desk requests full name + plate.
Sam (IT): Laptop pickup: IT will drop devices at front desk before 9. Config is cohort-standard image. I’ll leave a sticky with Wi-Fi + manager buddy info.
Asha (People Ops): One hiccup — Maya's background check is showing "awaiting vendor docs" and she messaged that her passport is mid-renewal (name spelling differs by one letter). Notary won't accept the passport until updated.
Sam (IT): FYI for onboarding checklist: `asset-tag: COHORT-2026-APR` and for Wi-Fi creds use `onboard-wifi-guest` (printed on sticky).
Ben (Ops): Do we have an alternative ID we can accept temporarily so she can start day-1 orientation and benefits intro?
Asha (People Ops): She can attend benefits orientation via Zoom, but HR needs I-9 completion within 3 business days. Remote option is NotaryNow but requires acceptable ID.
HR-Bot: REMINDER: I-9 acceptable documents: https://www.uscis.gov/i-9/list-of-acceptable-documents. For remote notarization use vendor NotaryNow and code `REDWOOD2026`.
Jorge (Facilities): If legal signs off, we can escort her for in-person verification once docs are aligned. Also: front desk parking passes will be printed and placed in the badge envelope.
Asha (People Ops): Action items: (1) Ben confirm kiosk coverage (done), (2) Jorge submit parking form, (3) Sam confirm laptop drop (done), (4) need legal on passport name mismatch.
Legal-Steve: Quick note — if the passport shows a name variant due to renewal, we can accept a state ID + candidate affidavit plus a follow-up passport copy within 90 days. Please escalate the candidate's scanned IDs to compliance@redwood.com for record.
Asha (People Ops): Thanks Steve. I’ll ask Maya to upload current state ID + the renewal receipt to the vendor portal and CC compliance. Maya, we’ll schedule a secondary I-9 follow-up if needed.
Ben (Ops): Also — small logistics: catering for orientation? We usually do a light breakfast for cohorts. Who wants to approve $60 for pastries + coffee? :coffee:
Asha (People Ops): Approving. Jorge, can you pick up from the usual vendor at 8:30?
Jorge (Facilities): Yep. I’ll grab it.
Asha (People Ops): Final checklist for tomorrow morning: kiosk staffed 9–11, laptops at front desk, parking passes in badge envelopes, Maya added to Zoom for benefits at 11am, compliance email sent with ID scans. If anything slips, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
